name: Pyromancer: Living Flame adds 10% crit chance to Ember Touch (#2421)
contract: #2421: Living Flame 704851 is a passive ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) with MiscValue 7 = SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, value 9+1 = +10, class mask A 0x40 of family 30, which selects Ember Touch 800818 and its rank chain. Unit::SpellDoneCritChance ends with ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) (Unit.cpp:9694), so the modifier reaches the crit roll natively and no module code is involved. Asserts the native crit-chance modifier for Ember Touch is 0 before and +10 after learning the passive, and that the same modifier does not touch an unrelated spell (Frostbolt 116).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without Living Flame the crit modifier is nil
Living Flame adds 10 crit chance to Ember Touch
The modifier does not reach an unrelated spell
